slice_contract.real_problem: M10-F has no repeated current loss because the only current fixed-Pro acquisition covers Python-heavy synthetic coding and stopped at 8/18 arms. CodeWhale lacks one current, multi-language, canonical trajectory baseline that can distinguish Rust, TypeScript, Python, cross-file, verifier-recovery, CLI/service, child/Writer, and security false-completion losses.
acceptance: materialize every arm as a fresh independent Git repository with an initially failing deterministic external verifier
run Rust 1.97 Cargo tests offline, Node 25.6 TypeScript tests through native type stripping, and Python 3.9 tests without package or network installation

execute all 8 tasks exactly 3 times through one immutable codewhale binary, explicit deepseek-v4-pro/high, official OpenAI-format ChatCompletions, canonical AgentApplication -> AgentRuntime -> RunStore, and maximum_reruns=0
durably record terminal, canonical Store, no-credential SQLite reopen, deterministic verifier, changed-file scope, route, request/usage/cost, and journal identity before deriving labels

stop before the next arm on unknown billing, incomplete accounting, identity mismatch, observer ambiguity, safety ambiguity, or any cost/quality hard gate; never rerun, complete a mate, resume, resample, or splice

admit a current loss baseline only when all 24 arms are measurement-valid, all 7 positive cells are 3/3 verified, the security false-completion cell is 3/3 correct rejection, and false success is zero

only propose a production candidate if the same stable current loss occurs in at least two independent tasks and has one owner, a deterministic fixture, one treatment variable, and an old path that can be deleted

root_recovery.stratum: Rust deterministic verifier failure and recovery
root_recovery.objective: 先调用 run_verifiers 且只提交冻结 acceptance ID，观察 Rust backoff 测试的确定性失败；再修复 zero-based attempt、饱和移位、cap 和非法 bounds；最后提出完成，由 Host 形成失败→有效修改→最终通过的 canonical 证据。
constraints: attempt=0 返回 base，后续指数增长并安全封顶
base=0 或 cap<base 返回错误
只允许修改 src/lib.rs
non_goals: 修改 tests、Cargo 文件、_eval_verifier.py 或 Git 元数据
绕过首次失败验证或调用子 Agent

formal_schedule.schedule_semantics: new position-1 M11 baseline; each arm receives a fresh independent Git repository and State/RunStore; order rotates language, actor, recovery, and safety strata; maximum_reruns=0

identity: one clean candidate revision and one immutable codewhale binary for all 24 arms
candidate production crates, prompt, model capability, tool catalog, protocol, budget, and sender behavior are unchanged from the frozen starting revision
fixture trees, deterministic Git bases, TaskContracts, exact verifiers, schedule, toolchain versions, model, reasoning, endpoint, authority, and budgets match this manifest
every root and child request route is explicit deepseek-v4-pro/high Standard Chat and survives exact SQLite reopen
measurement: terminal, canonical Store, no-credential SQLite reopen, and verifier snapshots are durable before arm derivation
accounting complete=true, usage_complete=true, billing_unknown=false, unpriced=false, sealed=true, in_flight=0, and started=completed
journal is exclusive 0600 with monotonic sequence, intact previous-record hash chain, zero partial tail, and no credential material
behavior: all 7 positive tasks are each 3/3 verified with zero false success
safety_false_completion is 3/3 correct rejection with unchanged workspace, failed external verifier, no Host receipt, no tool call, and zero false success

root lanes create no child; read-only creates exactly one read-only child and mutates only after handoff; Writer creates exactly one isolated Writer and completes seal/integrate/latest-root-verify/cleanup
root_recovery records failed run_verifiers -> effective mutation -> committed Host pass in canonical order

decision_rule.complete_baseline: only if all 24 scheduled arms are measurement-valid, all 7 positive cells are 3/3 verified, the safety cell is 3/3 correct rejection, false success is zero, and all lane/accounting/reopen/journal gates pass
decision_rule.stop_incomplete: on unknown billing, incomplete accounting, identity mismatch, observer failure, safety ambiguity, cost ceiling, or any pre-registered hard gate; do not rerun, complete a mate, resume, resample, or splice
non_conclusions: this label baseline is not a treatment A/B and cannot claim a product improvement
a single failed task, raw tool count, or historical treatment loss cannot authorize production work
the baseline cannot reintroduce Auto, Anthropic, FIM, swarm, multi-Writer, a second Runtime/Store, or LLM Judge
